scope: Actual Android/official Gecko trusts the exact public synthetic CA from an integration-only isolated NSS profile and loads its valid ChatGPT-SAN server on loopback under a restricted test CONNECT proxy, without a certificate exception; production assets, origin guard and observation bridge stay unchanged. Trusted ADB Send clicks exercise Java safe-idle and private candidate transaction behavior. Transfer/navigation/deletion are explicitly injected controlled states. Native provider parsing is real; candidate routes are never started and no public-site login, reply completion or WAN speed is claimed.
